approval: User explicitly approved synthetic-only execution, then requested completion of the outstanding PR06A work after local merge; no private or host permission inferred

calibration.phase: sin(2*pi*h*hz*i/rate), directly from sample index; float32 round-trip before measurement
calibration.source_gain: min(1, 10^(-24/20)/source_rms); attenuation only, before float32 rounding
calibration.negative_tone: six-harmonic MIDI57, deliberately graded against MIDI58 or MIDI69
calibration.eligibility: Reference grid centers must be within stable bounds and their entire centered observer support inside the primary signal; all excluded centers retained with reasons
calibration.missing_estimate: Wrong on an eligible voiced reference, never silently excluded
calibration.unvoiced_reference: No pitch-accuracy denominator or correct frames; accepted pitch detections retained as false detections and fail the calibration negative control
calibration.wrong_target_control: Must fail the ordinary accuracy gate, with at least 99% eligible estimates exposing the deliberately wrong target by more than 25 cents
calibration.wrong_note_duration: Longest consecutive wrong eligible 10ms grid-cell span; descriptive sampled duration, not sub-grid or onset certification
calibration.execution: One exclusive protocol-keyed A1 claim; no automatic rerun or meter tuning. Standard-library process workers may parallelize offline measurement, not native callback timing.

stop: Failed calibration stops before any native A2/A3 capture. Preserve the meter, failures, source identities and complete report; do not alter thresholds, hide cases or continue against an uncalibrated observer.
